title: Overall love the app!
body: I love the experience and have benefited a lot from it. I wish i can integrate some tasks into calender though since then i can see them in it while i check as a reminder. Overall the best habit tracker on the market!
author: Minwaal

title: My To-Go App for Habit Tracking & Implementation
body: Simple and easy to use, with an intuitive designs, especially that feel-good feeling I get whenever I perform a habit/task and close a ring. One of my favorite and most important apps on my phone!
author: kenyap89

title: I wish there's couple more pages
body: This app have been great. I wish I could add more tasks
author: pj.666

title: crash after update
body: nice app but the app can’t open after the latest update. please fix it asap. thanks
author: swrougenine

title: Revise the UI
body:
Difficult to delete or change the title of activities once created. Also, the multiple pages which is not clear what the use seems to be. 

The UI should be better like utilize the 3D touch to delete or edit.
author: Pushuke

title: Excellent for productivity!
body: Most useful app out there in terms of productivity boost. I'm doing the things I should've been doing like I'm on a mission everyday. So much more fun and excellent for health & productivity! Very nice! :)
author: Nicky Khilnani
